page_title: LEV 2-3 RBL | Bayer Leverkusen v RB Leipzig 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+6' A pass lands at the feet of Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.
90+3' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' An attempted cross from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
90+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi reads it well and gathers the ball.

90+1' A cross, provided by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Benjamin Henrichs goes off and Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) comes on.
89' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) replaces Lois Openda.
89' Today's match ends for Kevin Kampl who will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
88' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
88' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen. Let’s see what happens!
87' The foul by Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) was seen by Matthias Jollenbeck who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
86' It's time for a substitution. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Edmond Tapsoba.
84' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

84' Peter Gulacsi makes a brilliant save! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
82' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matthias Jollenbeck, who decides to show him a yellow.
80' 2 - 3 Goal! Antonio Nusa tees up Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:3.
77' Here is a change. Jeremie Frimpong is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' It is time for a substitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is on for Victor Boniface.

76' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Peter Gulacsi, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
75' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
74' The attendance is 28000.
73' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to release Victor Boniface with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
71' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Martin Terrier.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benjamin Sesko as he is replaced by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig).
67' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
64' The free kick is taken by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig), but ball is cleared.
61' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
57' 2 - 2 Goal! Benjamin Sesko plays a pass to the feet of Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), and he shoots inside the left post from inside the box. It's 2:2.
57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is about to take a corner kick.

56' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Peter Gulacsi has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Bayer Leverkusen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Peter Gulacsi leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
54' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
53' The referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
53' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The RB Leipzig players aren’t happy.
53' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out for offside!
52' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:2.
52' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
52' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Matej Kovar sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
49' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Florian Wirtz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
46' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.

45+7' 2 - 1 Benjamin Henrichs produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:1.
45+6' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
45+3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Florian Wirtz sprays a pass out to Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
44' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
43' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take a corner kick.

43' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Peter Gulacsi!
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.

42' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
32' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is first to the cross from Lois Openda, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
31' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
26' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Marco Rose gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
26' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck has finally had enough of Marco Rose and brandishes a yellow card at him!
26' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
23' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
23' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
18' The referee gives a yellow card to Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen).
17' Corner kick. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to send the ball into the box.
17' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
16' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
15' Amadou Haidara is unable to continue after that nasty looking head injury. Marco Rose ushers on Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) to replace him.
15' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
15' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
12' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
12' The game is interrupted. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) suffers a horrific injury!
12' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
11' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

11' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
10' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.

10' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
8' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) wasted a big chance to finish after the resulting free kick! He latched on to a well-placed cross deep inside the box and produced a fine header towards the net!
5' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
3' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) dribbles into the box, but Matej Kovar is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
2' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball onto Victor Boniface, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' The first half has just begun.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
